description: The hidden web.groupme.com webview used only as an API fetch proxy when a network filter blocks the app's direct API calls (see proxy.rs). Like the main remote surface it is third-party code on a remote origin, so it gets nothing but the event channel — no filesystem, shell, window, or archive commands. It only relays fetch requests it is handed and returns the responses. Created lazily, so on an unfiltered network this window and capability never come into play.
